bibl.title: PL III/1040: frammento di pergamena LXX Regnorum III.10.22a; 26a.
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio, PL III/1040: frammento di pergamena LXX Regnorum III.10.22a; 26a.
bibl.note: A very small fragment of a parchment codex, from Antinoupolis and preserved in the Laurentian Library in Florence has been identified. It is a codex in Greek which contains two passages from the Books of Kings. IVth/Vth cent.
